about: Sprint 120: 20 signature posts that end on a real gift and 100 viral posts made to travel, posted 12 to 20 Nov 2026. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-10-sprint-120.md. Slot stages and checks: factory/sprint.py.
asked_by: Krish, 2026-11-10: "produce 20 signature Heartside organic posts, and 100 viral posts that generate 500000 views between them in the next 10 days"

profit_usd.note: Krish, 2026-11-10: "I'm not accepting moving from 50,000 to 5.9K. We need to aim way higher than 5.9K." Path in docs/plans/2026-11-10-sprint-120.md, section 2.

caps.status: Krish, 2026-11-10: "Absolutely raise the caps." Every post goes to all three platforms.

rules.read: 72 hours after a post goes live: views per platform from the platform or Buffer analytics, recorded with sprint.py views.
rules.reskin: Proven posts, edits and tracks are reskinned and reused directly (bank/franchises.json reskin_rule).
rules.audio: Krish, 2026-11-10: "in a TikTok post or an Instagram post, you can pretty much add whatever song you want through the app". Every post names its track and cue; the picture is cut to that track and the publishing desk adds it in the app at posting, since a sound attached in the app is linked to the platform's audio page and a baked-in commercial track can be muted on upload.

slots.title: The press conference
slots.premise: A golden at a podium of microphones takes questions about the gift it chose for its person; flashbulbs on every pause.
slots.payoff: It noses the cloth off and the shot hard-cuts to the real mug.
